home.subheadline: Deployable zero-emission energy. Powered by compressed air. Engineered for anywhere the grid can't reach.

technology.subtitle: From compressed air to clean, continuous energy.
technology.intro: AirPower's patented system transforms ambient air into clean, on-demand power using a closed-loop cycle. With no fuel, no combustion, and only cold air as its byproduct, the AirPower Station redefines how energy is generated, stored, and delivered — available in 20-foot (0.5MW) and 40-foot (1.5MW) containerized platforms.

s1.title: Ambient Air Compression
s1.description: Air is drawn from the atmosphere and compressed into onboard storage tanks using an integrated compressor system. The tanks in the AirPower Station fill in just 3 minutes to power the CAE for up to 16 hours runtime per fill cycle.

s2.title: Engine Activation
s2.description: Stored compressed air powers our proprietary compressed air engine (CAE), which converts air pressure into mechanical energy.

s3.title: Power Generation
s3.description: The engine drives an integrated generator to produce on-demand electricity — powering external equipment or charging the onboard battery storage system.

s4.title: Cold Air Exhaust
s4.description: As the engine operates, it releases only cold, dry air — no combustion, no emissions. Temperatures can reach below -35°C, making it ideal for industrial cooling applications.

s5.title: Optional Battery Storage (BESS)
s5.description: Excess energy generated is stored in an integrated 1.5MW lithium or graphene battery system for continuous uptime or backup use.

s6.title: Deployment & Use
s6.description: The AirPower Station can be installed on-site, mounted on trucks, or delivered to remote locations. It's built to power everything from data centers and grow operations to disaster relief zones and off-grid microgrids.

useCases.subtitle: From farms to AI labs — clean power, anywhere it's needed.
useCases.intro: AirPower delivers high-capacity, zero-emission energy across industries. Whether powering infrastructure, operations, or innovation, the AirPower Station makes clean energy accessible in places traditional power cannot reach.

productIntro.subtitle: The fully integrated, containerized energy platform.
productIntro.click: Click to hear how quiet it is
productIntro.headline: Zero-emission, closed-loop energy solution
productIntro.p1: The AirPower Station is a zero-emission, closed-loop energy solution — available in 20-foot (0.5MW) and 40-foot (1.5MW) containerized platforms and ready to deploy anywhere. It includes our proprietary compressed air engine (CAE), integrated generator, air tanks, and optional BESS (Battery Energy Storage System).
productIntro.p2: Designed to run continuously with cold air as its only exhaust, the AirPower Station delivers scalable, on-demand power wherever it's needed — without fuel, without emissions, and without compromise. With just a 3-minute air tank fill, it provides up to 16 hours runtime per fill cycle.

runtime.title: Up to 16 hours runtime per fill cycle

zeroEmissions.title: Zero emissions, cold air exhaust
zeroEmissions.description: Clean power with useful cooling byproduct

modular.subtitle: Multiple deployment formats. Same breakthrough system.
modular.intro1: The AirPower Station isn't just one product — it's a flexible energy platform that adapts to your mission. Whether truck-mounted or available in 20-foot (0.5MW) and 40-foot (1.5MW) containerized configurations, each unit delivers our full CAE + generator system, with optional BESS for battery storage.
modular.intro2: From mobile operations to permanent grid support, AirPower's modular design means clean, scalable power — wherever it's needed most.
